description: Create a new VOD Station streaming channel. Use dryRun=true to preview without creating.

accessPrivateFiles.description: Whether to allow access to private files in the bucket

cdnProfileId.description: Global Edge profile ID (required when createCdn=true)

createCdn.description: Whether to auto-create a Global Edge CDN

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating the channel

segmentDuration.description: Playback time per segment in seconds (default: 10)

segmentDurationOption.description: Segmentation method: BASIC (regular intervals) or VARIABLE (keyframe-based)

storageBucketName.description: Object Storage bucket name containing video files
